item.title: Nehemiah 5 Integrity Amid Pressure
item.description: Nehemiah 5 shows Nehemiah confronting injustice within God’s people and modeling integrity, humility, and godly leadership. This episode explores how Christians today can pursue justice and live with Christlike character under pressure.

item.title: The Cross: Where Justice and Mercy Meet
item.description: In this episode of Anchored in the Word, Dave Jenkins explains how the cross reveals God’s justice, displays His love, accomplishes substitutionary atonement, and brings reconciliation with God.

item.title: Forgiveness Is God’s Command, Not a Suggestion
item.description: Doreen Virtue explains Jesus’ command to forgive in Matthew 6:14–15, showing how God empowers us to forgive and walk in freedom.

item.title: Standing Firm Against Deception: Lessons from Nehemiah 6
item.description: In Nehemiah 6, Nehemiah faces deception, intimidation, and false accusations. This episode explores how Christians can stand firm by relying on God’s strength and discerning truth from lies.
